text:
anya: quick heads-up — vendor booked an external pentest for 2026-04-14 -> 2026-04-16. includes staging, our KMS proxy, and a light social engineering surface. need a short intake + remediation cadence.
marcus: ack. do we have the scope doc link?
anya: https://internal.docs/redwood/pt-scope-2026-04 (private). core ask: read-only access to a subset of staging services, logs, and ability to hit auth flow.
ravi: flag — we need an ephemeral KMS proxy and presigned S3 evidence bucket. prefer 48h presigned TTL, TTLs must be auditable.
elaine: for RBAC, propose a timeboxed role `pt/assessor-readonly` with MFA required and session duration 4h. will need a short-lived onboarding runbook.
sam: agree. ops-oncall should own the rollout of the ephemeral role and the proxy. i'll draft terraform stub.
ops-oncall: i can own the role swap window. suggest we do a dry-run on 2026-04-07 to validate flows.
anya: dry-run + artifact packaging test sounds good. vendor asked for evidence upload endpoint and audit proof that keys weren't exfiltrated.
ravi: suggested KMS pattern (sketch):
```
# KMS unwrap proxy pattern (concept)
POST /unwrap -> auth to proxy -> proxy calls KMS:Decrypt (customer-key)
proxy returns short-lived wrapped key to assessor client
```
we'll log proxy requests to the audit sink with request_id and src_ip.
marcus: we also need to confirm where audit logs land. are we still shipping to splunk-old or new-log-collector?
elaine: new-log-collector. retention policy for PT: keep immutable snapshots for 90 days in archive prefix `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-04-14/` with manifest signed by the proxy key.
anya: who owns signing key ops? is that KMS CMK or HSM?
ravi: CMK in customer KMS, policy: key usage limited to `kms:Sign` by `proxy-role`. output must include signature and sha256 manifest. sample command: `aws kms sign --key-id arn:... --message fileb://manifest.json --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256`
sam: i'll add the signing step to the evidence pipeline. also will add a `proof-check` lambda that verifies signature on ingest.
ops-oncall: RBAC schedule:
- 2026-04-06: apply test role in staging (disable auto-expiry)
- 2026-04-07: dry-run with vendor oncall
- 2026-04-13: final role bake and proxy warm-up
- 2026-04-14 -> 16: PT window (rotate creds nightly)
elaine: remediation cadence — we want 72h triage SLO for critical, 7d for high, 21d for medium. vendor retest window requested within 30 days.
anya: decision: open a JIRA epic `SEC-PT-2026-04` for tracking and add a checklist template. anyone want to own triage?
marcus: security-eng will own initial triage for first 48h, then hand to service owners for fixes.
ravi: make sure we tag fixes with `pt:ticket=<vendor-id>` so we can auto-generate evidence bundles.
elaine: retest plan: canary retest first (critical/high fixes only) over a 48h window, then full retest if more than 2 regressions. vendor needs evidence manifest for retest.
anya: @sec-bot can you create the JIRA epic stub and add required fields (evidence-s3-prefix, proxy-role-arn, audit-snapshot-id)?
sec-bot: created SEC-PT-2026-04-1 (epic) — https://jira.internal/SEC-PT-2026-04-1 :white_check_mark:
sam: small terraform snippet for role condition (will push to infra repo):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "pt_assessor" {
  name = "pt-assessor-readonly"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow",
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/proxy" },
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
      Condition = { Bool = { "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "true" } }
    }]
  })
  max_session_duration = 14400
}
```
ops-oncall: nice. also add `Condition: DateLessThan` for expiry on 2026-04-17 in the real rollout.
marcus: evidence hygiene: don't put PII in manifests. vendor asked to include request traces — include only hashed ids.
anya: are we comfortable with letting vendor run limited replay of traffic to reproduce flows?
elaine: allow synthetic replay in staging only; require pre-approved dataset and scrubbed payloads. add explicit ACL to block production endpoints.
ravi: last note — post-PT retrospective: include an audit extract and signatures, retention start date, and timeline. i'll prepare a template.
anya: thanks team. i'll convert this thread into the intake doc and attach to the JIRA epic. sending calendar invites for dry-run and PT window. :calendar:
marcus: i'll standby for the dry-run. :eyes:
ops-oncall: assigning myself on-call for the PT window and rotation.
sec-bot: reminder set: dry-run 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC.
anya: closing loop — anything else?
